items.title: 'Make a choice': Taylor defends comments aimed at non-citizens
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has defended his comments aimed at non-citizens as necessary and practical during a heated interview on 7.30.

items.title: The food, music and praise served up at the Trump-Xi state banquet
items.description: Guests dined on Beijing roast duck and tiramisu while the People's Liberation Army band performed some classic hits.

items.title: Leadership contenders edge towards challenging UK PM Starmer
items.description: The UK's health secretary has resigned from cabinet and another Labour MP has quit parliament paving the way for a potential leadership challenge to Prime Minister Keir Starmer.

items.title: Albanese taunts Taylor as another defector joins Labor ranks
items.description: After failing to catch anyone by surprise with the budget, Anthony Albanese had another trick up his sleeve.

items.title: Breaking: Sam Kerr to leave Chelsea Football Club
items.description: The Matildas star has spent over six years playing for the London-based team.

items.title: Here's how the Coles Down Down campaign duped shoppers
items.description: The pricing patterns of these six products show how Coles was found to have misled consumers through its Down Down pricing patterns.

items.title: ICC fugitive flees Philippine Senate after shooting chaos
items.description: Senator Ronald dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court on charges of crimes against humanity, had been holed up inside the Philippine Senate since Monday to avoid arrest. His whereabouts is now unknown.

items.title: Bus rollover on Queensland's Bruce Highway leaves one dead and many injured
items.description: Two other passengers suffered life-threatening injuries after the large coach overturned between Townsville and Bowen.

items.title: The key takeaways from Trump and Xi's meeting in China
items.description: From a red carpet welcome to a high-profile tech entourage and a pointed reference to Taiwan, here are the main takeaways from Donald Trump's meeting with Xi Jinping in China.

items.title: Who is in Trump's entourage of billionaires and executives in Beijing?
items.description: US President Donald Trump has brought a delegation of business executives for his visit to Beijing. Here's why they made the trans-Pacific trip.

items.title: Email reveals Jewish group warned police about Bondi gunman in 2019
items.description: A Jewish security agency raised concerns about Bondi Beach gunman Naveed Akram years before the terror attack that left 15 people dead, a document shows.

items.title: Seven dead, scores missing in Kyiv as Russia continues onslaught
items.description: Russia launches hundreds of drones at Ukraine in the third straight day of widespread attacks on targets across the country.

items.title: Latvian PM resigns in row over stray Ukrainian drones
items.description: Drones launched by Ukraine that were jammed by Russia either flew over or crashed in the Baltic country's territory, with local residents critical of the government's response.

items.title: Calls for more education following the suspected death of 'Sammy' the seal
items.description: Marine experts are calling for greater education on aquatic life following the death of a seal believed to be known by Mornington Peninsula locals as Sammy.

items.title: Green light for Andrew Forrest's $70m Ningaloo Reef resort
items.description: After almost a decade of planning, mining billionaire Andrew Forrest's plan to build an eco-resort on the shores of the Ningaloo Reef has received the go-ahead.

items.title: Mannagh's heavenly night leads Cats to statement win over Lions
items.description: Geelong records a 41-point win over Brisbane on the back of Shaun Mannagh's five-goal, 30-disposal performance at the Gabba.

items.title: Sexual abuse, a thwarted Olympic dream, and the sister who uncovered the truth
items.description: Ian Walker was one of the most promising athletes in the country until his life started to unravel, and the search for the truth in his tragic story has finally come to light.

items.title: Mouse plague so bad locals say driving feels like 'popping bubble wrap'
items.description: As locals in a Western Australian town battle a siege of mice, farmers still do not have permission to use a high-strength bait to combat them.

items.title: Miraculous try-savers hand NSW second straight Origin series win
items.description: For the second straight year, NSW secures the Women's State of Origin shield in Game II, with Jesse Southwell and Teagan Berry coming up with stunning try-savers to get the Blues over the line.

items.title: Power to cut funding and stricter 'permanence' test under new NDIS
items.description: Legislation designed to save $35 billion in NDIS spending is introduced to parliament, revealing new powers for the minister to cut funding to classes of supports, automate some decisions and create requirements for prospective participants to exhaust all other treatment options before entering the NDIS.

items.title: Can you put sneakers in the washing machine? Here’s what the experts say
items.description: Experts reveal their tips on bringing your favourite sneakers back to life at home.

items.title: Australian hantavirus ship passengers to depart for home today
items.description: Six passengers from a cruise ship at the centre of a deadly hantavirus outbreak are testing negative for the illness and are symptom-free, the federal health minister says, as they prepare to be repatriated to Australia.

items.title: Which country has won Eurovision the most? Take our More or Less quiz
items.description: We've put down our tiny flags and picked up our record books to challenge what you think you might know about Eurovision.

items.title: Blockbuster movies are connecting new audiences to classical music
items.description: From 19th-century concert traditions to Hollywood’s Golden Age, and back to the concert hall, movies are helping audiences experience live orchestral music.

items.title: Entire university sector accused of antisemitism failure
items.description: The special envoy on antisemitism has found not a single Australian university has met its requirements for adopting a definition of antisemitism.
